study_question.question: Can a frozen representation and relation operator recover a planted technical author relation from declared text records?

claim.target_estimand: Source-disjoint relation correspondence under the declared representation and operator.
claim.claim_statement: The registered synthetic text records support a reproducible anonymous technical relation object.

assumptions: The representation version is frozen within the study.
edge_licenses.evidence_or_test: Representation perturbation and coordinate-gauge checks are included.
edge_licenses.refusal_rule: Refuse transport when the registered support or gauge comparison fails.

assumptions: Fit and application splits are source-disjoint.
The relation operator is frozen before held-panel scoring.
edge_licenses.evidence_or_test: Planted positive, null, and alias worlds test recovery and refusal.
edge_licenses.refusal_rule: Refuse the technical object when support, null, or replicate gates fail.

target_population.definition: Authors generated by the registered synthetic world.
target_population.sampling_rule: Independent author draws from the frozen generator.
target_population.scope_limit: No claim about real people or unregistered generators.
target_population.refusal_consequence: Refuse population transport outside the registered world.

reference_population.definition: No person score or norm is produced at L4.
reference_population.sampling_rule: Not applicable to this technical relation estimand.
reference_population.scope_limit: The output remains cohort-relative technical geometry.
reference_population.refusal_consequence: Refuse any norm-referenced or individual-score interpretation.

context.sampling_rule: Balanced context allocation by the frozen generator.
context.scope_limit: Inference is conditional on the two fixed contexts.

opportunity.definition: A balanced event menu exposed to every synthetic author.
opportunity.sampling_rule: Identical menu support within each registered context.
opportunity.refusal_consequence: Refuse when positivity or menu overlap fails.

occasion_time.sampling_rule: Two source-disjoint replicate streams per author and context.
occasion_time.scope_limit: Replicates are technical views, not human trait occasions.
occasion_time.refusal_consequence: Refuse reliability claims beyond the replicate design.

operator.definition: Frozen representation, slicing, whitening, and relation operator.
operator.sampling_rule: One version is used for all splits after D0 fitting.
operator.refusal_consequence: Refuse coefficient or score transport after operator drift.

language_culture.definition: The synthetic generator has no language or cultural strata.
language_culture.scope_limit: No language or culture claim is licensed.

interaction_partner.definition: The synthetic records contain no interaction partner.
interaction_partner.scope_limit: No dialogue or interaction claim is licensed.

administration.definition: Deterministic synthetic generation under a frozen configuration.
administration.sampling_rule: Every repetition uses the same registered administration logic.
administration.scope_limit: This does not represent a human administration setting.

response_process.definition: The claim begins at stored text records rather than human production.
response_process.sampling_rule: No L0 or L1 inference is attempted.
response_process.scope_limit: Human effort, disclosure, strategy, and stress remain outside scope.
response_process.refusal_consequence: Refuse inference about how a person produced the text.

observation_design.choice_channel: Opportunity allocation is recorded separately and is not interpreted as preference.
observation_design.response_channel: Within-context event geometry is estimated separately from allocation.
observation_design.event_count_rule: The event budget is frozen in the configuration.
observation_design.event_composition_rule: Event identities and composition schedules are registered separately from count.
observation_design.repeated_opportunity_rule: Each author receives the same repeated support within context.
observation_design.missingness_selection_rule: The smoke world has complete support; missingness attacks are separate counterworlds.
observation_design.text_retention_policy: Synthetic raw event values and provenance are retained.
observation_design.assisted_authorship_policy: No assistant or coauthor exists in this synthetic world.

transformation_chain.fit_apply_separation: All fitted components use D0 only and are applied unchanged to held panels.
transformation_chain.reference_operator: not applicable at L4 technical-object level
transformation_chain.provenance_rule: Configuration, code revision, seeds, and output inventory are recorded.

identification.identification_set: All planted worlds with the same registered observable distribution.
identification.equivalence_class: Mechanisms producing the same observables receive one anonymous technical label.
assumptions: Registered technical replicates are conditionally independent given the planted author object.
D0 support is estimable and comparable to held support.
alias_or_counterworlds: Null author world with no replicated relation.
Gauge-alias world with different hidden coordinates and identical observables.
identification.support_condition: Both held panels must pass the frozen support and positivity gates.
identification.dependence_model: Authors are independent; event dependence follows the registered within-author generator.
identification.residual_claim: Unexplained remainder is not called noise, personality, or innovation.
refusal_rules: Refuse unique mechanism naming under observational alias.

dependence_assumptions: Author bootstrap is the population-resampling unit.
Technical replicate dependence is handled by paired statistics.
error_theory.variance_or_relation_decomposition: Context and technical-replicate relation components are reported separately.
error_theory.uncertainty_target: The registered population technical relation in the synthetic world.
error_theory.uncertainty_method: Author-cluster bootstrap plus registered null worlds.
error_theory.reference_uncertainty: Not applicable because no L5 reference score is emitted.
error_theory.individual_sem: Not applicable because no individual score is emitted.
error_theory.minimum_detectable_difference: Not applicable because no individual change score is emitted.
error_theory.decision_consistency: Not applicable because no decision is enabled.

validation_route.development_confirmation_separation: Development seeds and any future confirmation seeds are disjoint.
validation_route.fresh_confirmation_rule: A later confirmation must attach independent randomness before truth generation.
validation_route.external_construct_evidence: Not applicable to an L4 anonymous technical claim.
validation_route.field_replication: Not applicable to synthetic development; required before a real-text generalization.
validation_route.information_budget_plan: Power and event-composition sensitivity are evaluated separately.
validation_route.stop_rule: Stop and retain the refusal if any registered support, null, or alias gate fails.

interpretation_boundary.claim_boundary: Synthetic L2-to-L4 foundation research only; no human, psychological, individual-score, or use claim.

application_overlay.consequences_analysis: Not applicable because no action or decision is enabled.
application_overlay.fairness_analysis: Not applicable in the synthetic world; mandatory for a future application.
application_overlay.human_authority: Not applicable because no person-level output is produced.

governance.mutation_policy: Changes create a new study contract and cannot overwrite this result.
